rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a person who invests money to make a profit.

example.english: I’m not a professional investor; I just want to make a little money from my savings.
example.traditional: 我唔係專業投資者，只係想用啲積蓄賺少少錢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 zyun1 jip6 tau4 zi1 ze2 zi2 hai6 soeng2 jung6 di1 zik1 cuk1 zaan6 siu2 siu2 cin4

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone who invests or trades in stocks, rather than for an investor in general.

example.english: As an investor, the most important thing is not to panic-sell at the slightest sign of trouble.
example.traditional: 做股民最緊要唔好一有風吹草動就亂咁沽貨。
